target_product.review_text:
This is a set of extra large rhinestones in different colors and shapes. For the most part, the rhinestones are about ¼” across, although there are some smaller round ones that are just 1/8” across. You get circles in 3 sizes, ovals, squares in 2 sizes, petals, tear drops, hearts, stars, and flowers. The rhinestones are not hotfix, so you need to supply your own adhesive. They come packaged in separate small ziplock bags. The rhinestones were made in China.

I had great fun with these rhinestones decorating some baseball caps. The leaf shaped stones also make great petals, so I used the rhinestones to make flowers for my hats. The stones are much bigger than other rhinestones that I have worked with. They are very eye catching. Overall, these rhinestones are easy and fun to work with.
